name: Knowledge Base Article
description: Creates support knowledge base articles with issue description, cause analysis, step-by-step resolution, and prevention guidance in a structured issue/cause/resolution/prevention format. Use when the user needs to write a KB article, troubleshooting guide, or support documentation. Do NOT use for user guides (use `user-guide`), internal wiki pages (use `internal-wiki-page`), or error messages (use `error-message-writing`).
